text: What did the stranger want at the stable? — drug the watchman
why: Paragraph 36 reports Hunter's account that the stranger drugged the curried mutton and so left the stables without their watchman, so the answer is stated in the story. The question is a plain one the story has already raised.

text: What was in the stranger's paper? — a drug
why: The story shows the stranger handing a folded paper packet through the window (¶24, ¶26) and reports that he drugged the mutton (¶36). A drug is a possibility the reader has reason to consider, though the story does not yet say outright what the packet held.
